name: TC-74: submitting without agreeing to terms does not submit the form
description: Filling every field but leaving 'agree to terms' unchecked and clicking submit sends no request, shows the 'You must agree to the terms' error and no success dialog.
descriptionHtml: Filling every field but leaving 'agree to terms' unchecked and clicking submit sends no request, shows the 'You must agree to the terms' error and no success dialog.

testStage.description: Filling every field but leaving 'agree to terms' unchecked and clicking submit sends no request, shows the 'You must agree to the terms' error and no success dialog.

steps.name: Navigate and fill the form without agreeing to terms
Submit and verify no request fires and no success dialog appears
Wait for event "request"
steps.statusMessage: TimeoutError: page.waitForRequest: Timeout 2500ms exceeded while waiting for event "request"
